basic.name: Sandra Chaparro
basic.summary: Full-stack software engineer building focused expertise in cybersecurity.
basic.about: I'm a software engineer based in the Dallas–Fort Worth area with a full-stack background spanning healthcare EHR platforms, dashboards, and client web products. I'm now transitioning into cybersecurity — grounded in real application security work I've done in production (authentication, authorization, and protecting sensitive data), and building focused knowledge in threat intelligence, OSINT, threat hunting, and AI security through certification study and self-directed learning. I care about technology that actually helps people, and I bring a developer's instincts to security problems: curious, detail-oriented, and always growing.

experiences.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built full-stack features for a specialty healthcare EHR — secure payment processing, appointment scheduling, and product sales modules serving 15+ practitioners.
Diagnosed and resolved critical performance bottlenecks by optimizing inefficient MySQL queries, cutting API response time from 3.5s to 207ms (a 70% reduction).
Strengthened API security by implementing authentication and authorization middleware across endpoints, preventing unauthorized access to sensitive patient information.

experiences.title: Web Developer
bullets: Designed and deployed responsive websites, improving user engagement and cross-device usability.
Partnered directly with business owners to translate needs into high-performance web solutions.
Implemented automated CI/CD pipelines with Vercel and Git, achieving 100% zero-downtime deployments.

experiences.title: Computer Science Tutor
bullets: Provided individualized instruction to 10+ students in Java, JavaScript, and C++ through hands-on coding and pair programming.
Designed and implemented a curriculum focused on Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) best practices, resulting in a 35% improvement in student code quality metrics.

experiences.title: Software Engineer Co-Op
bullets: Developed a centralized React dashboard with OAuth 2.0 authentication integrating the Jira API, providing real-time project visibility across sites.
Built responsive Bootstrap front-end interfaces, improving page load performance and data interactivity.
Completed FedRAMP compliance training covering security controls, authorization requirements, and industry best practices for services handling federal government data.
